url.description: A full URL you can use to download the call recording. If the recording is still in progress, this property does not appear.

transcribe.description: Contains properties related to the transcript for this recording. This package is only present if a transcript was made.

language_code.description: A code indicating the language you set for the transcription.

transcription.description: Contains additional properties related to the transcript.

reference_id.description: Specifies the Telesign Voice call for which you want to retrieve or delete recordings.

file_name.description: The name of this call record file. If the recording is still in progress, this property does not appear.

status.description:
The status of the recording. Possible values are:
* `recording` - The call recording is still in progress. It is not yet available for retrieval.
* `available` - The call recording is complete and available for retrieval.
* `deleted` - The call recording has been deleted and is not available for retrieval.

date.description: The UTC+0 date when the recording was created. It follows this format: {YYYY}-{MM}-{DD}T{hh}:{mm}:{ss}.

Transcription.title: Transcription
Transcription.description: Contains additional properties related to the transcript.

status.description: The status of generating the transcript. Note that there is a delay of up to a few seconds between completion of the call recording and completion of the transcript.

result.description: The text transcript of this call recording. If the recording has been deleted, this property is not returned.
